commit.message:
RISC-V: Add SHA3 GPR intrinsic

Implement SHA3 implCompress, implCompressMB, and double_keccak stubs using scalar GPRs. Keep the Keccak state in registers across rounds and use Zbb rori and andn instructions for the Rho and Chi steps.

Enable UseSHA3Intrinsics when Zbb is available and update the SHA3 test predicates for RISC-V.
